note: Erdae names and wording of the diplomatic actions (diplomacy_l_english.yml), of the engine war goal types (goals_l_english.yml), and of the exile and research sharing windows. Keys are the engine's; every placeholder is kept. Terms follow the master glossary: realm, league, liege, vassal, Oath of Peace, Right of Passage, Pledge of Protection, Sending Arms, Lent Captains, Close the Roads, the Gathering Dark.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_DESC: Choose a cause of war to declare it.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_GOALS_LIST_HEADER: We hold these causes of war:
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_ON_FOREIGN_STATES: We cannot declare war on a vassal of another liege.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_ON_OTHERS_AS_SUBJEC: A subject cannot declare war on its own account.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_JUSTIFY_WARGOAL_NO_OTHERS_AS_S: A subject cannot justify a cause of war on its own account.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_TRUCE: A truce binds us to them
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NONAGRESSIONPACT: An Oath of Peace binds us to them
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NONAGRESSIONPACT_LE: An Oath of Peace binds us to the Lord of their league
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NONAGRESSIONPACT_MA: An Oath of Peace binds us to their liege
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NONAGRESSIONPACT_YO: An Oath of Peace binds them to the Lord of our league
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NONAGRESSIONPACT_BL: - The oath cannot be broken in the first $UNBREAKABLE|Y$ months after it was sworn.
- Between $MONTH_FIRST|Y$ and $MONTH_SECOND|Y$ months you may break the oath if you keep $RATIO_BALANCE|%0Y$ of their number of hosts along our common border.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NO_WARGOAL: No cause of war to justify a declaration.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_NO_WARGOAL_OR_WAR: No cause of war to justify a declaration, and no war with a threat we can name.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_WAR_NO_WAR_TROOPS_IN_TERRITORY: We have hosts in their lands.

They will receive $AMOUNT|%H$ of the Spoils the council can give.

Our request for a right of passage was §Gaccepted§! by §Y$COUNTRY$§!.

Our hosts may now march through their lands.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! §Gaccepted§! our call to join the war.

Our offer of an Oath of Peace was §Rrefused§! by §Y$COUNTRY$§!.

§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Gaccepted§! the offer to join our new league.

For their sake and ours, we will lead it.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_DECLINED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Rrefused§! the offer to join us in a new league.

We must look elsewhere for friends.

§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Gaccepted§! the offer to join our league.

We stand together.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_DECLINED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Rrefused§! our offer to join our league.

Alone, they will not last.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Gaccepted§! our request to join their league.

We stand together.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_DECLINED_MESSAGE_DIPLO: §Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Rrefused§! our request to join their league!
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Gaccepted§! the arms we send.

Our gifts will strengthen their hand.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_DECLINED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Rrefused§! the arms we send!

They will not have our support.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Gaccepted§! the changed terms of our arms.

Our steady support goes on.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_DECLINED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Rrefused§! the changed terms of our arms!

They will no longer have our support.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_ACCEPTED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Gaccepted§! our offer of peace.

The fighting between our realms has ceased.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MESSAGE_DECLINED_MESSAGE_DIPLO:
§Y$COUNTRY|U$§! has §Rrefused§! our offer of peace.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_ASKSTATECONTROL_DESC: To hold a conquered land means keeping down its resistance, and it gives you its yield, its levies and its workshops.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_GIVESTATECONTROL_DESC: Handing over a conquered land can ease your hold on the unruly, and gives your league's members its yield, its levies and its workshops.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_REVOKE_OFFER_MILACC_DESC: Let us keep the vile $COUNTRY|Y$ out of our lands.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_CALL_ALLY_ACTION_DESC: Call a friend into this war
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_CALL_ALLY_REQUEST_DESC: $COUNTRY|UY$ asks for our help in their war.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_JOIN_ALLY_REQUEST_DESC: $COUNTRY|UY$ offers to help in our war.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_NAVAL_BLOCKADE_ACTION_DESC: We can stop a realm from trading by sea, so long as our fleets rule the sea-lanes it uses.

Our war $OUR_WAR|Y$ has joined with $NEW_WAR|Y$
Our friends in this war are now:
$ALLIES_LIST|Y$

And our foes are:
$ENEMIES_LIST|Y$

These realms were not allowed to join the joined war:
$COUNTRY_LIST|Y$
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_IMPROVERELATION_DESC: Win the realm's good will with gifts and envoys.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_IMPROVERELATION_ACTION_DESC: Win their good will with gifts and envoys.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_NONAGGRESSIONPACT_DESC: Swear not to make war on each other.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_NONAGGRESSIONPACT_ACTION_DESC: Swear not to make war on each other.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_CREATE_FACTION_DESC: Forms a league with $COUNTRY|Y$. Both realms may call each other to war. Any volunteers sent or received between us will be sent home.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_CREATE_FACTION_REQUEST_DESC:
$COUNTRY|UY$ asks us to help found the league: $FACTION|Y$.
Any volunteers sent or received between us will be sent home.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_JOIN_FACTION_ACTION_DESC: If we join a league, we may join its wars and its members may join ours. We will fight together!
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_JOIN_FACTION_REQUEST_DESC:
$COUNTRY|UY$ asks to join our league $FACTION|Y$.
Any volunteers sent or received between the members will be sent home.
Usurpations staged between $COUNTRY|H$ and us will end of themselves.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_JOIN_FACTION_DESC:
Ask $COUNTRY|H$ to take us into $FACTION|H$. Then you may call each other to war. The Lord of the League is $LEADER|H$.
Any volunteers you sent to the members will be sent home.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_JOIN_FACTION_ACTION_DETAILED_D: Usurpations staged between you and them will end of themselves if you join their league
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_OFFER_JOIN_FACTION_DESC:
Invite $COUNTRY|UH$ to join $FACTION|H$. Then you may call each other to war. The Lord of the League is $LEADER|H$.
Any volunteers sent or received between the members will be sent home.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_OFFER_JOIN_FACTION_REQUEST_DES:
$COUNTRY|UH$ asks us to join their league: $FACTION|Y$.
Any volunteers sent or received between the members will be sent home.
Usurpations staged between $COUNTRY|H$ and us will end of themselves.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_OFFER_JOIN_FACTION_ACTION_DESC: Invite them to join our league.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_OFFER_JOIN_FACTION_ACTION_DETA: Usurpations staged between you and them will end of themselves if they join your league
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_KICK_FROM_FACTION_ACTION_DESC: Cast them out of our league.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_KICK_FROM_FACTION_POPUP_DESC:
$COUNTRY|UY$ will be forced to leave $FACTION|Y$.

The realms you cast out may take revenge.

Will you cast $COUNTRY|Y$ out of your league?
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_FACTION_DESC:
A league is a band of realms that stand by one another. If a realm makes war on a member, every other member joins the war. Members may be asked to join wars of conquest, but they may refuse.

Only the Lord of the League may invite new members.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_ESPIONAGE_ACTION_DESC: Direct our agents' schemes against them
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_INCOMING_LEND_LEASE_EXISTING_T: Change the Arms Sent to Us
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_INCOMING_LEND_LEASE_CANCEL_TIT: Stop the Arms Sent to Us
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_LEND_LEASE_ACTION_DESC: We can aid other realms at war by sending them arms.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_LEND_LEASE_CANCEL_ACTION_DESC: Stop sending arms to this realm.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_LEND_LEASE_EXISTING_ACTION_DES: We can aid other realms at war by sending them arms.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_LEND_LEASE_AMOUNT_AND_FREQ_DES: Choose how many arms to send each month.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_INCOMING_LEND_LEASE_EXISTING_A: We can ask other realms to aid us with arms.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_INCOMING_LEND_LEASE_CANCEL_ACT: Stop receiving arms from this realm.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_REQUEST_LICENSED_PRODUCTION_AC: Ask for a licence to make foreign arms for your own use.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_MANAGE_LICENSED_PRODUCTION_EXI: Ask for new licences, or end the licences now in force.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_CANCEL_LICENSED_PRODUCTION_ACT: End every guild licence that can be ended

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_CANCEL_ACCESS_TO_LICENCE_PRODU: End their sight of our guild licences
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_REQUEST_INTERNATIONAL_MARKET_A:
Open each other's arms at the Great Fairs.

Members of one league have fair rights with one another without asking.
Fair rights would let us buy arms from each other's stalls.
$COUNTRY|UY$ asks for fair rights, so that we may buy and sell arms to each other.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_REVOKE_INTERNATIONAL_MARKET_AC:
End our fair rights and theirs.

We will no longer buy arms from each other.
We will no longer buy arms from each other.
diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_GENERATE_WARGOAL_DESC: The cause will cost you $DAILYCOST|Y$ Authority a day and last $DAYS|Y$ days

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_REQUEST_EXP_FORCE_ACTION_DESC: Take charge of a number of hosts from a vassal. Your hold on its court is so strong that it will always agree.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_SEND_VOLUNTEERS_ACTION_DESC: We can send volunteers to aid other realms in their wars, so long as they are not our friends in a league.

Try to foment a usurpation on behalf of a party at this realm's court.
The strength of the plot depends on the standing of that party in the target realm.

diplomacy_l_english.yml.DIPLOMACY_SUCCESSFUL_COUP_DESC: $COUNTRY1|UH$ has fomented a usurpation in $COUNTRY2|H$ and it has succeeded. The flames of revolt now burn.
